title: Basic Commands [grep]

# grep
`grep` searches for text inside files.
```bash
grep "word" filename
```
It prints every line that contains the match.

Useful flags:
- `grep -i` - case insensitive
- `grep -r` - search recursively through directories
- `grep -n` - show line numbers - `grep -C/-A/-B NUM` - returns NUM lines around text. -A prints the line of and NUM lines past the occurence, -B prints the line and NUM lines before it, and -C prints the line and NUM lines in both directions.
